{{Quote|Gladiator command. Combine magic with swordplay.|Description}}
'''Spellblade Tech''' {{J|魔法剣技|Mahō Kengi|Magic Sword}} is the action ability for the [[Gladiator (Tactics Advance)|Gladiator]] in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.
